metadata.match_title: Guyana Amazon Warriors Women vs Barbados Tridents Women
metadata.status_note: Guyana Amazon Warriors Women won by 7 wickets

ball_by_ball.commentary_text: FLICKED FOR FOUR! Fast hands on display. Green had shuffled to the leg side. She got followed up by a full toss and adjusted beautifully to send the ball flying towards the backward square leg boundary. Barbados Tridents Women finish with 69/4.
Short ball that sits up below shoulder height. Green pulls it, from in front of the off and middle, towards deep backward square leg, where Grimmond fumbles to allow the second run.
Hard length, off stick or thereabouts, seems to have hit the bat hard. Vastrakar bunts it towards the front of point and scampers through for one.
Fuller, at the poles. Muscled to long-on for a run.
HEAVED AWAY! FOUR! Length ball angled in at the leg stick. Green shuffled half a step towards her left and then whacked it towards deep midwicket, where the fielder dived but could not stop it.

Slammed over mid-off for two. Full ball from over the wicket, outside off. Green lofted it and Nadine de Klerk, leaped leftwards like a Superwoman, only to get her fingertips on it. Harsh to call it a drop.
Even slower, 68.7 kph, fuller side of good length. Green allows it to deep and then, crouches to drag it from outside off to deep midwicket. Single taken.
Outside off on a length. Stabbed to deep point for a single.

OUT! Soft dismissal. Clever bowling from Connell. She hurled it on a length, wide of off – making Bates reach for it. But most importantly, she slowed it up to 78.5 kph. The batter went with it using hard hands — can't blame her for it in the penultimate over  — and found the point fielder.

OUT! Soft dismissal. Clever bowling from Connell. She hurled it on a length, wide of off – making Bates reach for it. But most importantly, she slowed it up to 78.5 kph. The batter went with it using hard hands — can't blame her for it in the penultimate over  — and found the point fielder.
PULLED FOR SIX! Short ball, not far from the off stick, sat up well below chest height. Bates did not quite go onto the backfoot but did swat it away over square leg.
Another slower ball, full in length, off stick or thereabouts. Nudged towards the front of square leg for a run.
Off-pace ball on a full length, 89.9 kph, at the pads, from over the wicket. Bates muscles it to short fine leg and will get only one run for it.
Full, darted outside off stump at 85.2 kph. Bates, down the wicket, thumps it down to long on. Just a single.
75.4 kph, full, just outside off. Green, down the wicket, mistimes this towards the cow corner region. Just a single.
On the fuller side, wide of off, miscued towards the deep square region. The batters push for two and get them.
On the fuller side, outside off stump. Green, down the wicket, drives and times it well, but finds mid off with it.
Tossed up outside off stump at 77.4 kph. Bates works this towards deep mid wicket and gets off the mark.

This is very close - Hayley Matthews might be a goner trying to pinch a second run! Full toss, wide of off from over the wicket. Matthews drives this towards the cover region. The batters chance an improbable second as the throw comes in to the right of Campbelle at the keeper's end. She collects, takes the bails off as Matthews dives to make her ground. Third umpire has a look, and SEES MATTHEWS WELL SHORT OF HER GROUND AS THE BAILS CAME OFF. The Tridents lose their second!

This is very close - Hayley Matthews might be a goner trying to pinch a second run! Full toss, wide of off from over the wicket. Matthews drives this towards the cover region. The batters chance an improbable second as the throw comes in to the right of Campbelle at the keeper's end. She collects, takes the bails off as Matthews dives to make her ground. Third umpire has a look, and SEES MATTHEWS WELL SHORT OF HER GROUND AS THE BAILS CAME OFF. The Tridents lose their second!

Mix-up... mix-up... the throw's at the wrong end! Darted full and outside off, Green thumps this straight to cover, who fumbles. Green was halfway down in search of a run, but was sent back by her skipper. The throw is at the bowler's end, and Green makes it back safely.
Quicker, on a length outside off stump. Green punches it back to the bowler.
Reverse-hit, BOUNDARY! On a length, outside off stump. Green rocks back somewhat, having seen the length, and paddles this the other way, past the left of short third!
Down the track, MAXIMUM! Tossed up outside off stump, Green runs down the wicket, gets right under it, and thumps it over the bowler's head, and over the ropes towards a straight-ish long off!

MATTHEWS IS CAUGHT, but off a no ball - Grimmond has overstepped! On a length, outside off stump. Matthews moves across her stumps, looks to sweep this towards square leg, the ball takes the top half of the bat and descends upon the fielder circling at square leg, she takes the catch, but to no avail.
On a length, outside off stump. Matthews looks to cut, misses. The ball drops onto the stumps off Campbelle's gloves.
Slog sweep, SIX! 83.5 kph, tossed up outside off from over the wicket. Matthews, down on one knee, gets under it, swings across the line, and clears cow corner by some distance!
On a length, outside off stump. Matthews hangs back, works it towards square leg and will retain strike.
80 kph, tossed up outside off. Matthews moves across, looks to sweep, misses and is struck on the pad.

Matthews runs down the wicket to this length delivery outside off at 74.8, and misses it completely. Campbelle reluctantly takes the bails off, but given Matthews didn't attempt a run at any stage, she is safe.
75.2 kph, on a length, outside off stump. Green hangs back and clubs it towards long on without timing it right. Matthews wanted two but was sent back. Burns has overstepped.
On a length, outside off, this one turns in and bounces sharply. Matthews hangs back, adjusts to the bounce and works it towards mid on for a single.
On a length, outside off stump. Green hangs back and cuts this towards point. Gets off the mark.

Down the track, but NAVGIRE IS OUTFOXED BY BURNS AND IS SMARTLY STUMPED! Burns sees Navgire charge down the wicket and drags her length back, landing it outside off stump from over the wicket. Navgire goes through with a heave across the line, is far from connecting with the ball. Campbelle fumbles initially, but keeps her composure and whips the bails off!

Down the track, but NAVGIRE IS OUTFOXED BY BURNS AND IS SMARTLY STUMPED! Burns sees Navgire charge down the wicket and drags her length back, landing it outside off stump from over the wicket. Navgire goes through with a heave across the line, is far from connecting with the ball. Campbelle fumbles initially, but keeps her composure and whips the bails off!
Good length ball on leg stump. 84.8 kmph. Qiana comes down the track and heaves it off the inner half of the blade to square leg for one.
Grimmond spots Qiana to move across to off side and she bowls the slower around leg stump on good length. Qiana swings hard, but she misses.
Around the wicket for the southpaw. Three-quarter length around leg stump at 83.2 kmph. Qiana moves leg side to clobber it downtown, but she gets the inside edge to the keeper.
Good length ball on fifth stump. Hayley punches the 83.1 kmph ball to deep cover for one.
A dot to end the powerplay. Grimmond takes the pace-off from the length ball outside off. Matthews misses the back foot punch.

SIX RUNS! Hayley compensates for Qiana's slow start and hits the first maximum of this eliminator. Grimmond from over the wicket. Short ball around off stump and it turns in. Hayley goes back and mauls it over deep midwicket for a 64-meter long hit.
Single to finish the over. Good thing for Tridents is that Hayley retains the strike. A hard length ball on middle stump. She tucks it to backward square leg and crosses the ends.
Good length ball outside off. Hayley pushes it to short third.

FOUR RUNS! The skipper starts doing her job right from the word go. Good length delivery on fifth stump line. Hayley shuffles her back leg across to off stump and cuts it to thread the gap between point and short third for a boundary. She announces herself in style.
Hayley Kristen Matthews gets the strike. Tridents will feel chuffed about it. Good length ball around off stump. Qiana swipes it to deep forward square leg for one.
Wide ball. Slower on length, but outside the tramline. Qiana misses to slash the 89 kmph ball.
Connell follows Qiana to move leg side and bowls a length ball, attacking her pads. Qiana mistimes back to the bowler.
Dot balls galore! Connell starts from over the wicket. Fuller than good length on the pads. Qiana misses the heave and gets it on the pads. The ball pitched outside leg.

Finally Qiana Joseph and the Tridents Women are off the mark. Short of length ball on middle. Qiana mistimes the pull, but she clears the in-field. Deep midwicket fielder mops it up and it is a single.

Five dots in a row. A massive thing inside the powerplay of a truncated game! Ismail drags the length back outside off. Qiana looks to thump it over mid-off, but mistimes. Luckily for her, it lands safely near mid-off.
Back of length slower from Shabnim wide of off stump. Qiana swings at it, but gets beaten again.
Three-quarter length ball on middle stump. Qiana drives it on a bounce to mid-on.
Thudded on the pads. Appeal from Ismail, but not given. Fuller and straighter on off stump. Joseph heaves at it, but gets an inside edge after which, the ball hits her pads.

Right then. After a delay of nearly a couple of hours, the eliminator kicks off. Shabnim Ismail from around the wicket. Good length ball around off stump. Qiana swings wildly at it, but connects only thin Bridgetown air.

innings.header_summary: Guyana Amazon Warriors Women Inning 75/3 (7.2 ov)

ball_by_ball.commentary_text: SIX RUNS! TAKE A BOW- CHLOE TRYON! There could not have been a more fitting finish to this eliminator game. Skipper tonks it out of the ground and takes her team home. 88.2 kmph. Length ball around off stump. Tryon bends her back knee and slams this one over deep midwicket for a maximum. Guyana Amazon Warriors will come again tomorrow to fight for the trophy against Trinbago Knight Riders Women. And it is over for Barbados Tridents Women!

WICKET! WE ARE NOT DONE YET! Suzie Bates gets Nadine de Klerk. Around the wicket. A tossed up ball, full on the leg stump. Nadine stays leg side of it to flick, but plays all around it. She gets beaten on the under edge and the ball crashes onto the leg stump. HANG ON FOLKS! There is something still left in this game.

WICKET! WE ARE NOT DONE YET! Suzie Bates gets Nadine de Klerk. Around the wicket. A tossed up ball, full on the leg stump. Nadine stays leg side of it to flick, but plays all around it. She gets beaten on the under edge and the ball crashes onto the leg stump. HANG ON FOLKS! There is something still left in this game.

SCORES ARE LEVEL! Guyana Amazon Warriors Women are just a run away from the final. 72.6 kmph. Length ball outside off. Too wide from the off stump. Nadine shuffles to meet the ball and she sweeps. It turns away to beat her and the outside edge goes to short third. Single taken.
Good length ball outside off. Brits aerially plays it to long-off for one.
Good length ball around off stump. Brits misses the square drive.

FOUR RUNS! Brits brings victory closer to the Amazon Warriors. Flighted and full delivery well outside off. Brits moves across to meet the ball at the line of his pitching and sweeps it through the cow corner region for a boundary.
Length delivery just outside off stump. Brits misses the cut.
Another wide. 73.9 kmph. Fuller than good length well outside the line. Brits is spot on with her judgement again.
This time it is a wide. Three-quarter length ball, well outside the tramline and Brits leaves it alone.
Afy Fletcher from over the wicket. Tossed up on length and wide of off. Brits leaves it for a wide, but it stays inside the line.
Good length ball on off stump. It turns in and Nadine moves across to sweep. She gets it off the upper half of the blade and it goes to the fine leg region. Keeper goes after it and keeps it to two.
69.9 kmph. Length ball, pitching on off and turning in. Brits shaped for the reverse sweep early and she waits to steer it to short third for one.
Flighted on a full length on off at 70.8 kmph. Nadine closes her bat face early and gets a leading edge. Luckily for her, it falls just short of Suzie Bates at mid-on. Single taken.
Good length ball on the top of off stump at 73.2 kmph. Nadine cuts it to backward point.
Length ball on middle. Much slower at 66.6 kmph. It turns in and Brits pulls it with the turn to Gajnabi at deep square leg for a single.

Two runs to start the sixth over. Hayley from over the wicket. Back of length on off stump at 80.3 kmph. It stays low, but Brits does well to drag it to the left of Gajnabi at deep square leg for one.

Appeal for a caught behind... umpire Williams seemed to signal wide initially but paused. There was a sound as the ball passed the bat, Hayley Matthews sends it upstairs. On the shorter side, wide of off stump, Campbelle looked to slam this over cover, didn't get enough bat on it. UltraEdge shows a spike as the ball passed the toe end of the bat. Campbelle HAS TO WALK BACK!

Appeal for a caught behind... umpire Williams seemed to signal wide initially but paused. There was a sound as the ball passed the bat, Hayley Matthews sends it upstairs. On the shorter side, wide of off stump, Campbelle looked to slam this over cover, didn't get enough bat on it. UltraEdge shows a spike as the ball passed the toe end of the bat. Campbelle HAS TO WALK BACK!

Appeal for a caught behind... umpire Williams seemed to signal wide initially but paused. There was a sound as the ball passed the bat, Hayley Matthews sends it upstairs. On the shorter side, wide of off stump, Brits looked to slam this over cover, didn't get enough bat on it. UltraEdge shows a spike as the ball passed the toe end of the bat. BRITS HAS TO WALK BACK!
On a length, outside off stump. Brits moves across her stumps and swipes at it, sending it towards cow corner. Just a single.
82.1 kph, length, outside off, spins away and stays low. Brits fails to get bat on it trying to cut.
78.8 kph, length, wide of off stump. Brits looked to slash over cover, was beaten.

HEAVED INTO THE SIR GARFIELD SOBERS PAVILION! SIX! On the fuller side, outside off stump. Brits reaches out to it, has a heave across the line, the ball makes a crunching sound off the bat and flies wide of long on!
Better line - just outside off stump at 69.2 kph, on a length. Brits looks to cut, is beaten as the ball spins away.
Round the wicket, on the shorter side at 71.1 kph. Well past the width of the tramline. Wide called.
Darted fuller, on middle. Brits, down the wicket, muscles it down to long on and collects a single.
84 kph, on a length, pushed across the batter. Brits drives off her back foot, but finds the fielder in the ring towards cover.
On the shorter side, on leg stump. Pulled towards the deep square leg fielder. Campbelle wanted the second, but was sent back.

Down the track... HEAVED OVER COW CORNER! 83.7 kph, darted on a length around leg stump. Campbelle, down the wicket, reaches out and swings across the line of this one. She middles it, and clears the boundary to the left of deep mid wicket!
87.8 kph, on a length, around leg. Brits swats it towards short fine and collects a single.

Sliced.... past short third, WHO FAILS TO KEEP IT INSIDE THE ROPES! On a length, darted across the batter. Brits hangs back, tries to drive, ends up slicing it past the left of short third. The fielder does get to the ball, gets a hand to it, but can't stop it from trickling onto the ropes!
Round the wicket, darted full, but down leg. Wide called.
Good length, spins to finish near the tramline on the off side. Campbelle tries to reach it by moving across but fails to connect. The umpire deems it a fair ball.
Similar length, outside off. Campbelle leaves it, but this one finishes inside the tramline.
Hung up on a length, spins to finish way outside off. Campbelle leaves it and earns a wide ball for her team.
HAMMERED FOR FOUR! Salt, wounds... you know it. Full toss in line with the off peg. Campbelle walked into it and then bludgeoned it to the long-on boundary.

Run out chance BOTCHED! Brits gets a life. Similar length, but quicker and wider. The batter moved across before heaving it to Vastrakar at square leg. The throw from the fielder was perfect, but Fletcher could not collect it cleanly at the bowling end. One run completed.

POWERFUL! SIX! Belligerent stuff from Brits. Similar length, outside off. This time, the batter cleared her front leg, crouched and tonked it over long-on. End of the powerplay. Brits put the "power" in the play in that phase.
Hung up on a drivable length, at the stumps, from over the wicket. Creamed to Deol at mid-off.

HIGH... INTO THE BREEZE.. ALL THE WAY! SIX RUNS! It was not quite off the middle of the blade but still cleared the ropes. Campbelle advanced. Matthews dropped it short in response, whilst keeping it in line with the poles. However, the batter adjusted and then, swished it over the square leg boundary.
Quicker, 82 kph, at the middle and leg, slightly shorter too. Pulled towards the left of Navgire at deep midwicket for a couple.
Lobbed up on a length at 69.8 kph, from around the wicket, at the leg stick. Campbelle steps out and heaves across the line, but fails to put the ball away.
Slows it up to 77.4 kph, gets it to pitch outside off on a good length and spin in towards the body. Brits dinks it towards square leg for a run.
THUMPED! FOUR! Brutal from Brits. Shorter than ideal once again, outside off, from over the wicket. The batter stood firm and flat-batted it past mid-off.
Starts around the wicket, drops it short, at the poles. Campbelle pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Top-edged... over short fine leg. Shorter side of good length, angled in at the pegs. Campbelle swished across the line and failed to connect in the middle of the bat. She still gets a single.
Fuller, angled in at the middle stick. Brits walks out of her crease and then, whips it towards the leg side sweeper to get off the mark with a single.
Shorter side of good length, not far from the off pole. Campbelle pulls it towards midwicket, where Green moves rightwards to cut it off. Single.

OUT! Dismissed off a juicy full toss. Brathwaite will be kicking herself. Hector was surely going for a yorker but failed to land it. It end up near thigh-high for the batter who wanted to wallop it over the straight boundary. Alas, she did not get her timing right and could not even clear the inner ring. Harleen Deol, at mid-off, did well to settle under it and gobble it.

OUT! Dismissed off a juicy full toss. Brathwaite will be kicking herself. Hector was surely going for a yorker but failed to land it. It end up near thigh-high for the batter who wanted to wallop it over the straight boundary. Alas, she did not get her timing right and could not even clear the inner ring. Harleen Deol, at mid-off, did well to settle under it and gobble it.
Fuller, off stump or thereabouts. Brathwaite opens her shoulders and lofts it over mid-off. The ball slows up in the outfield and therefore the batters have to settle for two.
A tad shorter, and importantly, way outside off. Brathwaite could not reach it. Wide ball.

Starts with a full ball at the pads, from over the wicket. Brathwaite attempts a flick but fails to connect. The ball deflects off her left leg and the keeper does well to move to her right and cut it off. No run.

partnerships.raw_text: Hayley Kristen Matthews & Kiran Prabhu Navgire 16 (7b)

Fuller, at the poles. Muscled to long-on for a run.
HEAVED AWAY! FOUR! Length ball angled in at the leg stick. Green shuffled half a step towards her left and then whacked it towards deep midwicket, where the fielder dived but could not stop it.

Slammed over mid-off for two. Full ball from over the wicket, outside off. Green lofted it and Nadine de Klerk, leaped leftwards like a Superwoman, only to get her fingertips on it. Harsh to call it a drop.
Even slower, 68.7 kph, fuller side of good length. Green allows it to deep and then, crouches to drag it from outside off to deep midwicket. Single taken.
Outside off on a length. Stabbed to deep point for a single.

OUT! Soft dismissal. Clever bowling from Connell. She hurled it on a length, wide of off – making Bates reach for it. But most importantly, she slowed it up to 78.5 kph. The batter went with it using hard hands — can't blame her for it in the penultimate over  — and found the point fielder.

OUT! Soft dismissal. Clever bowling from Connell. She hurled it on a length, wide of off – making Bates reach for it. But most importantly, she slowed it up to 78.5 kph. The batter went with it using hard hands — can't blame her for it in the penultimate over  — and found the point fielder.
PULLED FOR SIX! Short ball, not far from the off stick, sat up well below chest height. Bates did not quite go onto the backfoot but did swat it away over square leg.
Another slower ball, full in length, off stick or thereabouts. Nudged towards the front of square leg for a run.
Off-pace ball on a full length, 89.9 kph, at the pads, from over the wicket. Bates muscles it to short fine leg and will get only one run for it.
Full, darted outside off stump at 85.2 kph. Bates, down the wicket, thumps it down to long on. Just a single.
75.4 kph, full, just outside off. Green, down the wicket, mistimes this towards the cow corner region. Just a single.
On the fuller side, wide of off, miscued towards the deep square region. The batters push for two and get them.
On the fuller side, outside off stump. Green, down the wicket, drives and times it well, but finds mid off with it.
Tossed up outside off stump at 77.4 kph. Bates works this towards deep mid wicket and gets off the mark.

This is very close - Hayley Matthews might be a goner trying to pinch a second run! Full toss, wide of off from over the wicket. Matthews drives this towards the cover region. The batters chance an improbable second as the throw comes in to the right of Campbelle at the keeper's end. She collects, takes the bails off as Matthews dives to make her ground. Third umpire has a look, and SEES MATTHEWS WELL SHORT OF HER GROUND AS THE BAILS CAME OFF. The Tridents lose their second!

This is very close - Hayley Matthews might be a goner trying to pinch a second run! Full toss, wide of off from over the wicket. Matthews drives this towards the cover region. The batters chance an improbable second as the throw comes in to the right of Campbelle at the keeper's end. She collects, takes the bails off as Matthews dives to make her ground. Third umpire has a look, and SEES MATTHEWS WELL SHORT OF HER GROUND AS THE BAILS CAME OFF. The Tridents lose their second!

Mix-up... mix-up... the throw's at the wrong end! Darted full and outside off, Green thumps this straight to cover, who fumbles. Green was halfway down in search of a run, but was sent back by her skipper. The throw is at the bowler's end, and Green makes it back safely.
Quicker, on a length outside off stump. Green punches it back to the bowler.
Reverse-hit, BOUNDARY! On a length, outside off stump. Green rocks back somewhat, having seen the length, and paddles this the other way, past the left of short third!
Down the track, MAXIMUM! Tossed up outside off stump, Green runs down the wicket, gets right under it, and thumps it over the bowler's head, and over the ropes towards a straight-ish long off!

MATTHEWS IS CAUGHT, but off a no ball - Grimmond has overstepped! On a length, outside off stump. Matthews moves across her stumps, looks to sweep this towards square leg, the ball takes the top half of the bat and descends upon the fielder circling at square leg, she takes the catch, but to no avail.
On a length, outside off stump. Matthews looks to cut, misses. The ball drops onto the stumps off Campbelle's gloves.
Slog sweep, SIX! 83.5 kph, tossed up outside off from over the wicket. Matthews, down on one knee, gets under it, swings across the line, and clears cow corner by some distance!
On a length, outside off stump. Matthews hangs back, works it towards square leg and will retain strike.
80 kph, tossed up outside off. Matthews moves across, looks to sweep, misses and is struck on the pad.

Matthews runs down the wicket to this length delivery outside off at 74.8, and misses it completely. Campbelle reluctantly takes the bails off, but given Matthews didn't attempt a run at any stage, she is safe.
75.2 kph, on a length, outside off stump. Green hangs back and clubs it towards long on without timing it right. Matthews wanted two but was sent back. Burns has overstepped.
On a length, outside off, this one turns in and bounces sharply. Matthews hangs back, adjusts to the bounce and works it towards mid on for a single.
On a length, outside off stump. Green hangs back and cuts this towards point. Gets off the mark.

Down the track, but NAVGIRE IS OUTFOXED BY BURNS AND IS SMARTLY STUMPED! Burns sees Navgire charge down the wicket and drags her length back, landing it outside off stump from over the wicket. Navgire goes through with a heave across the line, is far from connecting with the ball. Campbelle fumbles initially, but keeps her composure and whips the bails off!

Down the track, but NAVGIRE IS OUTFOXED BY BURNS AND IS SMARTLY STUMPED! Burns sees Navgire charge down the wicket and drags her length back, landing it outside off stump from over the wicket. Navgire goes through with a heave across the line, is far from connecting with the ball. Campbelle fumbles initially, but keeps her composure and whips the bails off!
Good length ball on leg stump. 84.8 kmph. Qiana comes down the track and heaves it off the inner half of the blade to square leg for one.
Grimmond spots Qiana to move across to off side and she bowls the slower around leg stump on good length. Qiana swings hard, but she misses.
Around the wicket for the southpaw. Three-quarter length around leg stump at 83.2 kmph. Qiana moves leg side to clobber it downtown, but she gets the inside edge to the keeper.
Good length ball on fifth stump. Hayley punches the 83.1 kmph ball to deep cover for one.
A dot to end the powerplay. Grimmond takes the pace-off from the length ball outside off. Matthews misses the back foot punch.

SIX RUNS! Hayley compensates for Qiana's slow start and hits the first maximum of this eliminator. Grimmond from over the wicket. Short ball around off stump and it turns in. Hayley goes back and mauls it over deep midwicket for a 64-meter long hit.
Single to finish the over. Good thing for Tridents is that Hayley retains the strike. A hard length ball on middle stump. She tucks it to backward square leg and crosses the ends.
Good length ball outside off. Hayley pushes it to short third.

FOUR RUNS! The skipper starts doing her job right from the word go. Good length delivery on fifth stump line. Hayley shuffles her back leg across to off stump and cuts it to thread the gap between point and short third for a boundary. She announces herself in style.
Hayley Kristen Matthews gets the strike. Tridents will feel chuffed about it. Good length ball around off stump. Qiana swipes it to deep forward square leg for one.
Wide ball. Slower on length, but outside the tramline. Qiana misses to slash the 89 kmph ball.
Connell follows Qiana to move leg side and bowls a length ball, attacking her pads. Qiana mistimes back to the bowler.
Dot balls galore! Connell starts from over the wicket. Fuller than good length on the pads. Qiana misses the heave and gets it on the pads. The ball pitched outside leg.

Finally Qiana Joseph and the Tridents Women are off the mark. Short of length ball on middle. Qiana mistimes the pull, but she clears the in-field. Deep midwicket fielder mops it up and it is a single.

Five dots in a row. A massive thing inside the powerplay of a truncated game! Ismail drags the length back outside off. Qiana looks to thump it over mid-off, but mistimes. Luckily for her, it lands safely near mid-off.
Back of length slower from Shabnim wide of off stump. Qiana swings at it, but gets beaten again.
Three-quarter length ball on middle stump. Qiana drives it on a bounce to mid-on.
Thudded on the pads. Appeal from Ismail, but not given. Fuller and straighter on off stump. Joseph heaves at it, but gets an inside edge after which, the ball hits her pads.

Right then. After a delay of nearly a couple of hours, the eliminator kicks off. Shabnim Ismail from around the wicket. Good length ball around off stump. Qiana swings wildly at it, but connects only thin Bridgetown air.
